purpose: Evaluate the already frozen v0.7 operator on a substantially deeper sensor-space coarse-graining ladder without changing any scientific parameter after observing the result. This run is intended to remove the two-nonterminal-scale degeneracy of the 4-channel Muse validations, not to establish universality or clinical validity.

source.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
source.subject: S001
source.checksum_policy: At runtime, extract the SHA-256 for exactly S001/S001R02.edf from the versioned PhysioNet SHA256SUMS.txt and require the downloaded EDF to match before parsing or analysis.
source.montage: international 10-10 system as documented by PhysioNet

input_contract.channel_policy: Use every non-annotation data channel parsed from S001R02.edf that the parser types as EEG. No result-dependent channel subset, ranking, rejection or relabeling is allowed.
input_contract.annotation_policy: EDF+ annotation channel is excluded by the existing parser and never enters the operator.
input_contract.resampling_policy: No intentional resampling: all 64 documented EEG channels are expected at 160 Hz. Any parser-reported target sample rate other than exactly 160 Hz is a hard validation failure.

frozen_operator.filter: existing frozen v0.7 path; at 160 Hz this is 1-40 Hz
frozen_operator.coarse_grain: existing deterministic greedy descending PLV*NMI bundle weight

scale_ladder_gate.reason: Unlike a 4->2->1 recording, this ladder provides six nonterminal pairwise scales before the single-node terminal state, so any log-scale fit is no longer a two-point identity by construction.

parity_gate.python_oracle: Reuse tools/validation/v07_reference.py unchanged for all numerical operator steps. Add a source-specific, independently authored EDF reader that performs only standards-based EDF decoding, physical scaling, annotation exclusion and channel delivery.
parity_gate.kotlin_path: Parse the same checksum-verified EDF with the existing EdfBdfParser, require 64 EEG channels at 160 Hz, then call the unchanged CouplingFieldV07Engine.
parity_gate.comparison: Compare every scale metric and every pair metric, including ordering and labels, at every emitted scale.
required_invariants: engine, signal-engine and EDF-parser Git blob identities unchanged

interpretation_guardrails: No parameter, channel selection rule, filter, threshold, coarse-graining rule or tolerance may be changed in response to this run's numerical result.
A green Kotlin-vs-Python result validates reproducible implementation transport; it does not prove the physical correctness of the model.
A multi-scale pattern in one subject/run is evidence about this frozen operator on this recording only and is not a universality claim.
Q remains a normalized coupling-loss proxy, not physical power.
chi_dyn remains a ridge VAR(1) spectral-radius coordinate, not a calibrated L/C ratio.
This remains sensor-space and is not source localization, diagnosis, biomarker validation or causal inference.
